Produce the weekly, monthly, and quarterly business review packages (WBR/MBR/QBR), evolving them from backward-looking reporting into forecast reviews that connect operational KPIs to financial outcomes. Deliver monthly budget-to-actual variance analysis on volume, revenue, and contribution, with written commentary that explains cause rather than restating the variance. Doctor FP&A & Business Partnering Serve as the day-to-day finance partner to Operations and Sales & Marketing, responding to provider and operator financial questions with accuracy and speed. Cohort, Four-Wall & Portfolio Analytics Stand up referral cohort analysis and integrate it into the monthly reporting cadence, with the objective of improving cohort NPV retention. Build patient cohort retention analysis from the ground up, establishing the baseline measurement the organization currently lacks. Support the indirect costing process that underpins four-wall EBITDA evaluation, including allocation methodology, documentation, and sensitivity testing of allocation choices. Reporting, Systems & Recap Readiness Maintain the addback tracking schedule with supporting documentation sufficient to withstand quality of earnings diligence. Prepare recurring financial reporting delivered to the sponsor and lender group, working to a standard where the package requires review rather than rework. Partner with the Controller and Accounting Manager to support a high-quality close and to test, validate, and adopt new finance systems (ERP, Workday) and the processes that surround them. Experience supporting a planning system implementation is a plus. Strategic instinct paired with analytical rigor. The role requires someone who can build the analysis and then say what it means and what should be done about it. Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to present to executive audiences and to hold their own in a room with operators and physicians. Comfort with ambiguity, a bias toward building rather than waiting, and unquestionable integrity. Why This Role This is a high-visibility seat with direct exposure to the CFO, COO, and the private equity sponsor, in an organization that is actively building its finance infrastructure rather than maintaining a finished one.
